generations.name: First generation (Ultium)
generations.notes: Electric ZDX on GM Ultium (built by GM, shared with Lyriq/Prologue): 102 kWh pack, RWD/AWD and Type S. Not the 2010-2013 gasoline ZDX (out of scope). Acura ended it after the 2024 model year (announced September 2025), but EPA lists 2026 ZDX ratings with higher ranges; whether 2026 cars were sold is unclear, so last_year is left open for the owner. Confidence: medium (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://www.cars.com/articles/the-acura-zdx-is-dead-heres-how-to-get-a-deal-on-the-last-ones-516284 ; https://www.motor1.com/news/773465/acura-zdx-dead-discontinued/ ; https://fueleconomy.gov/feg/byMake/Acura2026.shtml
